top source crisp::link_data

CRISP pipeline

crisp::link_data [, /all_data], dirs=dirs [, pref=string] [, uscan=uscan] [, link_dir=link_dir]

Make links to raw data in the form that is required for momfbd processing with aid of crisp__extractstates_db docformat = 'rst' +

Keywords

all_data in optional type=boolean

Link not only complete sequences, but everything found

dirs
pref in optional type=string

Only process prefilter 'pref'

uscan in optional

link_dir in optional
